name: Huizhou Desay SV Automotive Co., Ltd.
summary: Huizhou Desay SV Automotive Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of automotive electronic products in China and internationally. The company offers smart cabin solutions, including smart display system, such as display system and head-up display; smart interaction system comprising instrument clusters, IVI, smart device, and smart amplifier; and smart domain controller platform, which includes smart vehicle control and smart cabin domain controller. It also provides smart driving solutions, such as smart driving computing system comprising assisted driving domain controller; and smart driving sensor, including camera, millimeter wave radar, and smart antennas.…
